title: 第二十一章 能有什么坏心思？
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
萧姚摸了摸下巴，狐疑地瞅了苍岚一眼。

    苍岚睁着圆溜溜的大眼睛，狼耳蹭上萧姚的手背，无辜地问：

    “姐姐？怎么了嘛？”

    萧姚被萌物击中，心底的微妙错觉被彻底抛之脑后，抬手摸了摸他的耳朵。

    熟悉的手感让萧姚有点上瘾，被乌龙砸个措手不及的憋屈，也在绒毛的解压中彻底释放。

    萧姚舒心地眯起眼，轻声哼着小调，可还是在间隙里听到几不可闻的抽泣声。

    萧姚刚放松下来的神经又瞬间紧绷，微闭的双眼睁得溜圆，撸得随心所欲的手也僵在原地。

    “小狼？”

    萧姚一时间有点手足无措。

    她手上没用力啊，她没捏疼他的耳朵啊。

    那他怎么哭了？他不喜欢被揉耳朵吗？

    可他不是自己说要当宠物的吗？不给摸的狼跟挠人的猫有什么区别？

    萧姚尴尬得准备收回手，苍岚却颤抖着捉住她的手腕，把她的手又按回自己头上，用力蹭了蹭。

    “姐姐，苍岚好开心……”

    “这几天，姐姐都对苍岚不冷不热的，苍岚还以为姐姐不要苍岚了……”

    “姐姐，这几天，我好难过……”

    萧姚看着少年红着鼻头眼泪汪汪的可怜样，心里软得一塌糊涂。

    本来是她自己心里拧巴，没想到对苍岚的影响居然这么大。

    也是，他自卑又缺爱，从来没被人放在心里过，哪怕行为极端了点，那也是为了活下去。

    他这几天的异常都是因为害怕吧，果然是自己想多了。

    粘人小狗不过是太依赖主人罢了，他能有什么坏心思呢？

    萧姚心下叹气，把侧脸贴在狼耳上轻轻蹭了蹭，安抚道：

    “姐姐最喜欢小狼。”

    “姐姐不会离开你，也不会不要你的。”

    “小狼乖，姐姐疼。”

    苍岚脸色爆红。

    他手忙脚乱地压住亢奋到不听指挥的尾巴，声音里也带着慌乱：

    “姐姐不骗人？姐姐你发誓！”

    萧姚好笑地重复一遍，只当哄小孩儿安心。

    苍岚也心满意足地缓缓笑开了。

    姐姐，这可是你自己说的，不许说话不算数哦……

    “姐姐……姐姐……”

    苍岚叫得又软又糯，带着亲近和依赖，撒娇似的蹭来蹭去。

    萧姚却突然坐直身子，拉开距离。
content_en:
Xiao Yao touched his chin and glanced at Cang Lan suspiciously.

Cang Lan opened her big round eyes, rubbed her wolf ears on the back of Xiao Yao's hand, and asked innocently:

"Sister? What's wrong?"

Xiao Yao was hit by the cute thing, and the subtle illusion in his heart was completely forgotten. He raised his hand and touched his ear.

The familiar feel made Xiao Yao a little addicted. The aggrieved feeling of being caught off guard by an oolong was also completely released in the decompression of the fluff.

Xiao Yao narrowed his eyes in relief and hummed a tune softly, but he still heard an almost inaudible sob in the gap.

Xiao Yao's nerves that had just relaxed suddenly became tense again, his slightly closed eyes widened, and his hands that he was stroking as he pleased froze in place.

"Little Wolf?"

Xiao Yao was a little at a loss for a while.

She didn't use any force on her hands, and she didn't pinch his ears painfully.

Then why was he crying?Doesn't he like having his ears rubbed?

But didn’t he say he wanted to be a pet?What's the difference between a wolf that won't be touched and a cat that scratches people?

Xiao Yao was so embarrassed that he was about to take back his hand, but Cang Lan grabbed her wrist tremblingly, pressed her hand back on his head, and rubbed it hard.

"Sister, Cang Lan is so happy..."

"In the past few days, my sister has been lukewarm towards Cang Lan. Cang Lan thought that my sister didn't want Cang Lan anymore..."

"Sister, I've been so sad these days..."

Xiao Yao looked at the young man's pitiful appearance with a red nose and tears in his eyes, and his heart felt so weak.

She was originally upset, but she didn't expect that it would have such a big impact on Cang Lan.

Also, he has low self-esteem and lacks love, and has never been taken into consideration. Even if his behavior is a bit extreme, it is just to survive.

His abnormal behavior these days is probably because of fear. Sure enough, he is overthinking.

The clingy puppy is just too dependent on its owner. What bad intentions can he have?

Xiao Yao sighed inwardly, rubbed the side of his face against the wolf's ear, and said comfortingly:

"My sister likes little wolf the most."

"Sister will never leave you, nor will she want you."

"Little wolf, be good, my sister is in pain."

Cang Lan's face turned red.

He hurriedly suppressed his tail, which was too excited to obey the command, and there was panic in his voice:

"Sister, you are not lying? Sister, you swear!"

Xiao Yao repeated it funny, just to reassure the child.

Cang Lan also smiled slowly and contentedly.

Sister, this is what you said yourself, don’t let your words count...

"Sister...sister..."

Cang Lan screamed softly and waxy, with closeness and dependence, rubbing against her like a baby.

Xiao Yao suddenly sat up straight and distanced himself.
title_en: Chapter 21 What bad intentions can you have?
